text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> PD:INC-98765. alerts: embeddings-queue > 1000, 5xx spike. auto-escalation to eng-oncall.
pagerbot: Autoclaim attempted: liam.k (on-call) -> claim failed (mobile unreachable). Escalating to rotation backup.
oncall-bot: @maya.nguyen you are primary on rotation now. Please ack in thread. :rotating_light:
maya.nguyen: ack. I'm on it, looking at embeddings queue dashboard.
liam.k: sorry fell asleep, laptop battery died. handoff acknowledged. @maya.nguyen take it, i'll standby.
maya.nguyen: quick context: saw a sudden rise in POST /embeddings 5xx from eu region. Error pattern is "stream closed" in agent logs. Customers 5-10% of requests returning 500s.
samir.p: noted. is this across Dedicated pools or Hosted? any correlation with recent deploys?
\
maya.nguyen: initial look: only hosted eu pool. No dedicated reports. No deploys in last 4 hours per deploy-bot.
\
ashley.w: adding runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-backpressure|runbook: embeddings-backpressure>. start with kvcache and ingress throttles.
\
maya.nguyen: executing quick checklist from runbook now.
- check queue depths
- check autoscaler logs
- check model process OOMs
\
maya.nguyen: queue depth snapshot:
```
emb-queue-eu-01: 1200
emb-queue-eu-02: 980
emb-queue-us-01: 20
```
\
maya.nguyen: autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts failing with allocation timeout on eu nodes.
\
samir.p: can you paste the failing allocator error from logs? Might be cloud infra throttling.
\
maya.nguyen: log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T08:42:10Z allocator: failed to attach GPU: Unavailable capacity error 429
2026-03-15T08:42:12Z scheduler: scale attempt retry #3
```
\
liam.k: if it's capacity, fallback routing should send to us-west model variant. Is that configured?
oncall-bot: Routing policy: eu-primary -> fallback us-west-1 with model-compat set to true. Fallback enabled but throttled by cross-region egress controls. Ticketing embargo in place for high egress.
maya.nguyen: customers impacted are on hosted API and haven't pinned region. We should temporarily relax egress policy for fallback to reduce customer impact. Requesting ops approval.
ashley.w: ops-approver here. what's the expected egress increase? quick calc?
samir.p: rough calc: if we divert 30% of eu traffic to us-west, egress ~120GB/hr. ops SLA window for emergency changes is open. I'm +1 for temporary egress relaxation for 30m and monitor.
ashley.w: approved for 30m. I'll apply relax-egress emergency flag. Applying now.
pagerbot: emergency flag applied: relax-egress=true. All routing proxies will honor fallback for 30 minutes.
maya.nguyen: flipping temporary fallback on via proxy toggle.
maya.nguyen: immediate effect: queue depths dropping on eu, us-west queues rising slightly. 5xx rate improving.
maya.nguyen: quick status: BEFORE: eu 5xx ~6.2% over 5m. AFTER fallback: eu 5xx ~1.1% and overall errors down to 0.9%.
samir.p: nice. keep an eye on latency for us-west customers—cross-region adds ~150ms p90.
liam.k: noting customer impact: small increase in p95 latency for EU-origin requests, but buys availability. recommend update to status page and a short note to affected customers.
maya.nguyen: will draft status update. "We're mitigating a partial capacity shortage in EU by routing traffic to alternate region; error rates reduced, slight latency increase may be observed. Engineers continuing monitoring."
maya.nguyen: monitoring for 15m window before we revert. Actions remaining:
- ops to request additional eu capacity from cloud (samir)
- runbook checks for allocator failures (maya)
- status page update (liam)
liam.k: I'll post the status page now. ping once we start revert.
samir.p: opened cloud request ticket CLD-45321: requested immediate capacity bump or replacement hosts. ETA 18-30m.
maya.nguyen: 12m into mitigation: metrics steady, eu queue ~200 each, us-west up ~300 total. continuing.
pagerbot: automated pager followup: PD:INC-98765 -> ack by maya.nguyen at 08:44:03Z. Escalation paused.
ashley.w: thanks @maya.nguyen. if cloud can't provide nodes, prepare for extended fallback plan (longer egress window + customer comms).
maya.nguyen: copy. will prepare notes. lean on dedicated customers contact path if they need guarantees.
maya.nguyen: 28m since mitigation: cloud ticket moved to provisioning in progress. suggest hold fallback until we see nodes healthy. we plan to revert in 5m and monitor.
liam.k: ready to flip revert. status page updated with "mitigation in progress; routing fallback enabled" and note about decreased errors.
maya.nguyen: reverting fallback now.
pagerbot: fallback toggle disabled by maya.nguyen at 08:52:10Z.
maya.nguyen: post-revert metrics: eu queue stable ~50 each, eu 5xx ~0.2%, overall healthy. closing incident in 10m unless regression.
samir.p: cloud provisioning completed: new eu hosts up. allocator attaching successful. CLD-45321 resolved.
maya.nguyen: thanks all. I'll post final summary and close PD. quick notes for postmortem: root cause likely transient cloud capacity loss causing allocator 429s; mitigated by temporary cross-region fallback and ops capacity provisioning. Recommend: add automatic egress emergency policy in runbook, improve early allocator alerting.
liam.k: +1 on postmortem and add a play for automated egress relax with approvals baked in.
maya.nguyen: closing PD now. pagerbot close.
pagerbot: PD:INC-98765 -> resolved by maya.nguyen at 08:59:10Z. :white_check_mark:
maya.nguyen: thanks everyone. reopening if anything else crops up. :bow:
